test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

My father said to me, “Slow and steady wins the race.”

options.text: My father told me that slow and steady win the race.
My father taught me that slow and steady wins the race.
My father taught me that slow and steady has won the race.
My father told me that slow and steady has won the race.

solution:
The correct answer is: '**My father taught me that slow and steady wins the race.**'
